top_signals.title: Kioxia Shares Up on $13 Billion Inflow Hope After JPX Review
top_signals.summary: Kioxia Holdings Corp.’s shares rose as much as 4.1% after Japan Exchange Group Inc. announced its weighting on the benchmark Topix index will be increased, a move that fueled expectations that an estimated ¥2 trillion ($12.7 billion) of passive inflows may be triggered.
